title: Internship Opening + Book Giveaway
summary: This announces an Executive Assistant internship at an AI answer optimization startup, along with the pay and full-time conversion terms, and how interested people can apply to receive a strategy book.
content:
Across Inc., a Hashed portfolio company and AI answer optimization (AEO/GEO) startup, is hiring an Executive Assistant.

- Posting: https://across.career.greetinghr.com/ko/o/208861
- Compensation: base pay of 3 million won + incentives of 1 million won based on KPI achievement
- Possible conversion to a full-time position after a 2-month internship; upon conversion, the 3 million + 3 million + 3 million won compensation structure applies

Everyone who submits the form below will receive one copy of the best-selling book, < AEO and GEO Survival Strategy That Gets Chosen by AI >.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScIRi8Fmg4bwJzu-mZuAznvGxagp11Xjfr1V542qsfOONe8qg/viewform

For inquiries, please email ask@gpto.kr. Thank you.
